articles.title: The AES for BARMM parliamentary elections: Ready or rushed?
articles.description: THE Commission on Elections (Comelec) is on a tight schedule as it prepares the automated election system (AES) that will be used for the first Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) parliamentary elections (BPE) on Oct. 13, 2025. While BARMM’s October polls are technically a continuation of the May 12 national and local elections, they must comply with the unique mandates of the Bangsamoro Electoral Code (BEC). They have embarked on key technical steps — local source code review (LSCR), trusted build execution, field testing, mock elections and international certification. But the compressed timeline raises questions about the depth of testing and community engagement in a conflict-sensitive environment.
